text: Security is a crucial part of web development that every developer must take seriously. First, websites should use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server, protecting sensitive information from attackers. Second, strong authentication helps ensure that only authorised users can access protected areas. Third, input validation is essential because it prevents users from submitting harmful data that could damage the system. Developers must also understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, and learn how to prevent them. By following these basic security practices, developers can build safer websites and protect both their users and their data from online threats.
